title: LabVIEW palette export (lvdocstring.json)
description: What the LabVIEW export writes for the docs: one entry per palette slot in lv_src/.vipb, plus one per instance of each polymorphic VI. A VI on two palettes appears twice, differing only in its palette location. Images are named by the MD5 of the VI's path and live in assets/ next to this file; the docs build uses only the file name of icon and connpane.

id.description: The owning class or library, ::, then the VI's full qualified name, e.g. "Nominal Client.lvclass::Nominal Client.lvclass:create.vim"; just the file name for a VI outside any library.

kind.description: "vi"; "polymorph[<qualified name>]" for a polymorphic VI; "polymorph[<parent's qualified name>][menu=<name>][selector=<name>]" for one of its instances. Menu and selector names are empty when the polymorphic VI doesn't set them.

path.description: The VI's path relative to lv_src, with backslashes, e.g. "Nominal Client\\Palette Items\\create.vim" or "..\\submodules\\nominal-streaming-labview-ffi\\lv_src\\Stream\\Shutdown.vi". Matches the Path of its item in lv_src/.vipb.

owner.description: The owning class or library, without extension; "" if none.

description.description: The VI's description as saved in VI Properties > Documentation.

icon.description: Path of the icon PNG; the docs build uses its file name, looked up in assets/.

connpane.description: Path of the connector pane PNG, like Context Help shows it; "<Not A Path>" for a polymorphic VI, whose instances have their own.

terminals.description: The connector pane's terminals. Empty for polymorphic VIs and for VIs without a connector pane (Quick Start and drop VIs).

relative palette location.description: The palette the entry was found in, by name from the top palette, e.g. "Files/MultiPart File Upload"; "" for the top palette.

parent ID.description: For an instance of a polymorphic VI, the polymorphic VI's id; "" otherwise.

caption.description: The control's caption; "" if it has none.

type.description: LabVIEW's name for the data type, e.g. "String", "Double Float", "Array[dims:1] of Cluster", "enum[INFO,FLAG]", "asset.lvclass".

type_id.description: The class or typedef that defines the type, "INVALID", or "".

default.description: The default value, as LabVIEW's XML flattening of a variant (<LvVariant>...). Arrays include their element type even when empty.
